key_highlights: RBA governor warns AI investment boom could be a bubble adding to inflation; migration cited as key economic driver
Saudi oil shock and global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) send Australian fuel prices surging, with shortage expected to persist into 2027
ASX mixed: tech stocks rally on Wall Street strength but rate fears and iron ore downside cap gains; market treads water
Iron ore downside persists as China rebalances towards robotics, pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' mode; federal/state governments 'careen off debt cliff'
Active gold exploration across WA/SA (Platina, Dalaroo, Broken Hill, Larvotto, Advance) signals continued ASX small-cap mining momentum
Intergenerational Report locks in mass migration; Hastie open to baby bonus return amid ageing concerns
Energy prices dump on US Democrat sweep prospects, offsetting some fuel shock pressure

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces structural downside as China pivots to robotics; gold exploration active across WA/SA with multiple ASX juniors advancing
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from weak iron ore; gold juniors (Platina, Dalaroo, Broken Hill, Larvotto, Advance) attract speculative flows but remain high-risk

sectors.trend: Saudi oil shock and global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) drive fuel prices higher; US Democrat sweep prospects cause energy price volatility
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WES.AX, BRL.AX benefit from higher fuel margins; transport and logistics costs rise, pressuring WES.AX, QAN.AX, JTA.AX

sectors.trend: Rate fears loom as RBA governor flags inflation risks from AI bubble and migration; fiscal debt cliff pressures sovereign credit
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure if RBA holds higher-for-longer; Super Retail (SRE.AX) under corporate governance scrutiny

sectors.trend: Jetstar staff protest over baggage fees; Virgin crew complaints; burger chain cancels breakfast; fuel costs squeeze consumer spending
sectors.implications: QAN.AX, JTA.AX face operational disruption; WES.AX, WOW.AX, CSG.AX under margin pressure from input costs

sectors.trend: ASX tech stocks rally on Wall Street strength; RBA warns AI investment boom could be a bubble; data centres threaten net-zero targets
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WTC.AX, XRO.AX) benefit from global rally but face valuation risk; data centre build-out (GRP.AX, STG.AX) faces policy headwinds

sectors.trend: Sydney housing 'bloodbath' continues; federal/state debt cliff threatens infrastructure and housing funding
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure; construction (WBC.AX, CGW.AX) exposed to funding gaps

key_themes: RBA inflation vigilance: AI bubble + migration as dual inflation risks
Global energy/diesel crisis: Saudi shock + Iran/Ukraine supply disruption to 2027
China demand rebalancing: iron ore structural weakness, robotics pivot
Fiscal sustainability: federal/state debt cliff, Intergenerational Report migration lock-in
ASX gold exploration wave: WA/SA juniors advancing through assay/demarcation stages
Housing market stress: Sydney bloodbath, funding gaps for hospitals and infrastructure
US political shift: Democrat sweep prospects driving energy price volatility

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / higher-for-longer due to AI bubble and migration-driven inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in fixed income; favour floating-rate and short-dated bonds; overweight financials with NIM resilience

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global diesel/fuel shortage persisting into 2027 (Iran, Ukraine, Saudi)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge transport/logistics exposure; favour energy producers (WDS.AX, BRL.AX); monitor A$ fuel import costs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore structural decline from China rebalancing to robotics
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and critical minerals exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fiscal debt cliff: federal/state governments facing unsustainable spending
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor sovereign credit spreads; reduce exposure to government-dependent REITs and infrastructure
Reduce Sydney-centric REIT and construction exposure; favour Melbourne/Brisbane diversification

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI investment bubble burst (RBA governor warning)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Take partial profits in ASX tech; diversify into value and dividend-paying sectors

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy producers and fuel retailers benefiting from diesel/oil shock
opportunities.rationale: Global diesel shortage to 2027 supports pricing power; WDS and BRL capture margin expansion

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to ASX gold explorers in WA/SA pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Multiple juniors advancing (Platina, Dalaroo, Broken Hill, Larvotto, Advance) with assay catalysts; gold hedge against inflation and China risk

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long ASX tech on Wall Street momentum, with tight stops
opportunities.rationale: Tech rally on global risk-on; but RBA AI bubble warning caps upside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and China-exposed materials weightings
defensive_moves.rationale: Structural iron ore downside from China robotics pivot; Xi under fire adds geopolitical risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Sydney-centric REIT and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing bloodbath and fiscal debt cliff threaten occupancy and project pipelines

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/short-duration bonds as RBA rate uncertainty persists
defensive_moves.rationale: Governor's inflation warning on AI and migration keeps rate path uncertain; avoid long-duration risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to range-trade with volatility. Tech rally supported by Wall Street but capped by RBA rate fears and iron ore weakness. Fuel shock adds inflationary pressure. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a tight band with sector rotation from materials to energy and gold.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from China demand rebalancing, fiscal debt cliff, and housing correction weigh on 6-12 month outlook. Gold and critical minerals offer relative strength. RBA policy path dependent on AI capex and migration-driven inflation. Moderate growth, elevated volatility.
